    Class TpTimefield

    Native time field with labels, constraints, picker access, and clearing.

    Example

    <tp-timefield label="Time" value="14:30" clearable></tp-timefield>

    Tagname

    tp-timefield

    Attr

    label = "" - Visible label associated with the native time input.

    Attr

    label-position = "top" - Label position (top, bottom, start, or end).

    Attr

    value = "" - Selected time in HH:mm or HH:mm:ss format.

    Attr

    min = "" - Earliest selectable time.

    Attr

    max = "" - Latest selectable time.

    Attr

    step = 60 - Time interval in seconds.

    Attr

    placeholder = "" - Hint forwarded to the native input; browsers may ignore it for date and time controls.

    Attr

    name = "" - Name submitted with the containing form; defaults to the initial inline content when omitted.

    Attr

    autocomplete = "" - Native autocomplete hint.

    Attr

    required = false - Marks the field as required.

    Attr

    readonly = false - Prevents value editing.

    Attr

    disabled = false - Disables the field and its action buttons.

    Attr

    clearable = false - Shows an embedded clear button while the field has a value. input Emitted when the selected time changes while editing. change Emitted when the selected time is committed. tp-clear Emitted after the embedded button clears the value.

    Cssprop

    [--tp-timefield-background=var(--tp-paper-color)] Field background.

    Cssprop

    [--tp-timefield-border-color=var(--tp-neutral-stroke-soft)] Field border color.

    Cssprop

    [--tp-timefield-focus-color=var(--tp-brand-text-colorful)] Focus border color.

    Cssprop

    [--tp-timefield-inline-size=10.5em] Field width.

    Cssprop

    [--tp-timefield-label-font-weight=500] Label font weight.

    Cssprop

    [--tp-timefield-label-gap=0.35em] Space between the label and its field.

    Cssprop

    [--tp-timefield-padding-block=0.6em] Vertical field padding.

    Cssprop

    [--tp-timefield-padding-inline=0.75em] Horizontal field padding.

    Cssprop

    [--tp-timefield-radius=var(--tp-border-radius-sm)] Field border radius.

    Cssprop

    [--tp-timefield-required-color=var(--tp-danger-text-colorful)] Required marker color.

    Cssprop

    [--tp-timefield-value-font-weight=400] Selected value font weight.
